title: Fallback on hierarchicalFacet
body:
If you don't declare your facet correctly in a widget config, it ends up using the hierarchical facet in place of giving a precise error.

example of wrong syntax -> 'facet' : \['lang'] in place of \['facet']:\['lang']

Don't know if you can do something with that. But it would definitely have helped me to get some help here.
